summary: All three fix_tasks discharged correctly. Log-privacy tests are now mutation-proof and production routes through the tested helper. Contract compliant.
notes: contract-check ok=true, violations=[]; not_checked: forbid.behaviors. 15 changed files, 1072 diff lines, docs/STATUS.md now 20 lines against the 30 per_class cap. 17/17 verify commands exit 0, 56 --- PASS lines against a threshold of 50.

FIX 1 VERIFIED AT THE SOURCE, not by claim. The QR goroutine in emparejamiento.go:84-91 now contains no logging of its own: it calls s.traducirItemQr(item) and forwards the result, nothing else. The six s.registro.Info call sites in the file are at lines 78, 110, 118, 123, 144 and 153; lines 110/118/123 are all inside traducirItemQr, so the helper is genuinely the sole place the QR pairing path writes to the log. There is no inline duplicate, which was the subtlest way this fix could have stayed vacuous. The mutation the orchestrator ran against the helper therefore does exercise the production path.

FIX 1, second half: TestElNumeroDeTelefonoNuncaLlegaAlRegistro exercises the real production function SolicitarCodigoDeVinculacion, not a helper, because EventoEmparejamientoPcSolicitado is emitted before whatsmeow rejects the leading-zero number. It asserts the emission actually happened before checking absence, and it checks both the raw number and the number without its leading zero.

Both new tests guard against their own vacuity: each one first asserts the expected log event IS present ('la prueba no estaria comprobando nada') and only then asserts the credential material is absent. That is the discipline whose absence caused the HEX-011 defect and my first-round revise verdict.

DELETION JUDGED CORRECT. The removed TestNingunPayloadDeEmparejamientoLlegaAlRegistro covered nothing that the two internal tests do not now cover far better: its non-blocking drain read zero items, so its only real effect was calling IniciarEmparejamientoQr, which TestIniciarEmparejamientoQrSobreAlmacenVacioDevuelveCanalSinError still covers. Net coverage strictly increased. The explanatory comment left at emparejamiento_test.go:95-99 points the next reader to where the assertion now lives and why it cannot live outside the package.

EXPORTED API DID NOT WIDEN. traducirItemQr is unexported and the new assertions live in almacen_interno_test.go, declared 'package canal'. A go doc -all diff of package canal between main and the worktree shows the added exported symbols are exactly the blueprint's declared set (AbrirAlmacenDeDispositivo, EstaEmparejada, IniciarEmparejamientoQr, SolicitarCodigoDeVinculacion, ErrYaEmparejada, ErrTelefonoNoConfigurado, ResultadoQr, DuracionCodigoQr and the Evento* constants) plus the NuevaSesion signature change. This fix round added no exported symbol at all, honouring the contract's 'do not widen a package's public API to serve a test'.

NO NEW DEFECT INTRODUCED by the three fixes. The test helper sesionVaciaDePrueba uses slog.LevelDebug only for its own in-memory buffer so that no line escapes observation; the production default threshold in internal/configuracion is untouched, so the contract's 'do not lower the default log threshold below info' still holds. Every database is still created under t.TempDir, no Connect/ConnectContext/live PairPhone round trip was added, and the suite still needs no network, no phone and no WhatsApp account.

RESIDUAL, not blocking and not fixable offline: no test asserts the DELEGATION itself, so a future edit that re-inlines the logging into the goroutine would not be caught by the suite. Driving that path requires a real websocket, which is stage A-3 task 15. I verified the delegation by reading the current source; it should be re-verified when task 15 lands a real-channel test.

CARRY-FORWARD MINORS, all non-blocking and none introduced by this fix round: canal.CerrarDB(*sql.DB) at canal.go:173 is dead exported code since main.go closes via contenedor.Close(); the EventoEmparejamientoRechazado constant is declared but never emitted; the errors.Is(err, whatsmeow.ErrQRStoreContainsID) branch at emparejamiento.go:72 is unreachable in practice because EstaEmparejada() reads the same dispositivo.ID and short-circuits first, so it is defensive depth rather than a coverage gap; and documento_test.go's field-agreement test matches a field name anywhere in the document rather than inside that type's own table, so it would not catch a field documented under the wrong type.

FIX 2 and FIX 3 accepted on the orchestrator's measurements: the CI paragraph is restored, the session claim now says credentials persist and reload so the session is resumable without re-pairing while Conectar remains a later A-3 task, which matches what the code actually does; docs/protocolo-ipc-nucleo-sidecar.md:80 and mensajes_test.go lines 13 and 212 now all say 'nueve tipos'.

STILL CLEARED FROM ROUND 1: the executable privacy guard at mensajes_test.go:211 is untouched, reachable and iterates ipc.TiposDeclarados() so it automatically covers the three new pairing types; no forbidden path is touched and adr-0011 remains unwritten; go.mod DIRECT requires are unchanged with the whatsmeow pin still e9a033b24933 and modernc.org/sqlite as the pure-Go driver; the contract amendment raising max_files_changed from 14 to 15 remains judged a legitimate correction of an internally inconsistent contract, not a laundered scope overrun.
